BEFORE_PUBLISH: Freeze hypothesis, topic score, format, title/thumbnail pattern, expected result and known confounds.
24H: Capture reach, CTR and first available retention; diagnose but do not declare a pattern winner.
72H: Update reach, packaging, retention and engagement; compare with channel/track/age-adjusted baseline.
7D: Record final test judgment as SUPPORTED, REJECTED or INCONCLUSIVE; do not promote one video to HIGH confidence.

diagnosis_tree.do_not_conclude: Do not first blame title or thumbnail without enough impressions.
Do not rewrite body before checking packaging.
Click success does not validate content delivery.

diagnosis_tree.condition: Good first 30s + poor average view duration
diagnosis_tree.do_not_conclude: Do not blame the opening alone.
Low comments alone do not prove poor information value.
Do not immediately reject the pattern.

result_rules.SUPPORTED: Pre-registered primary metric moves in expected direction with no critical Finance QA issue; still limited by sample/confounds.
result_rules.REJECTED: Primary metric moves against expectation in repeated comparable tests or the treatment creates clear harm.
result_rules.INCONCLUSIVE: Insufficient impressions, missing metrics, confounds, mixed signals, or only one observation.
